name: smiles
description: Parse, build, and manipulate SMILES molecular notation using smiles-js v2. Create molecules programmatically using Ring, Linear, FusedRing, and Molecule constructors with attach(position, fragment) API, or parse existing SMILES strings.

tools.name: parse_smiles
tools.description: Parse a SMILES string into an AST (Abstract Syntax Tree). Returns a JSON object with type, atoms, size, bonds, substitutions, and attachments. The AST can be modified and passed to build_smiles to regenerate SMILES.

smiles.description: SMILES string to parse (e.g., 'c1ccccc1' for benzene, 'CCO' for ethanol, 'CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O' for aspirin)

tools.name: build_smiles
tools.description: Build a SMILES string from an AST node object. Use after modifying an AST from parse_smiles or constructing one programmatically. Supports ring, linear, fused_ring, and molecule node types.

ast.description: AST node object with type ('ring', 'linear', 'fused_ring', or 'molecule'), atoms, size, substitutions, attachments, bonds, etc.

tools.name: decompile_smiles
tools.description: Convert a SMILES string to JavaScript constructor code using Ring, Linear, FusedRing, and Molecule constructors. Uses the v2 API with attach(position, fragment) argument order.

smiles.description: SMILES string to decompile to constructor code (e.g., 'Cc1ccccc1' produces Ring + Linear + attach code)

tools.name: validate_roundtrip
tools.description: Validate that a SMILES string can be parsed and regenerated with 100% structural fidelity. Returns the regenerated SMILES and a comparison if they differ.

smiles.description: SMILES string to validate for round-trip fidelity

tools.name: get_common_fragments
tools.description: Get a list of 40+ pre-built common molecular fragments organized by category: alkyl groups (methyl, ethyl, propyl), functional groups (hydroxyl, amino, carboxyl), aromatic (phenyl, benzyl), rings (benzene, cyclohexane, pyridine), halides (fluoro, chloro, bromo, iodo), and more.
